title: Site Configuration
description: Site-level metadata for the learning-ux-design-dsai template. The contract is documented in CONTENT-SPEC.md; the recipe for repurposing this template is in FORK.md.

$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema file. Enables IDE autocomplete and validation.

_comment.description: Free-form note about the file. Ignored by the build.

tagline.description: One-line pitch shown under the title.

description.description: Longer description used for SEO and meta tags.

url.description: Canonical URL of the deployed site.

email.description: Contact email for the site author.

bio.description: One-line bio shown on the about page.

items.description: kebab-case section slug. Must match a folder name under /content/lessons/.

primary.description: Section slugs in the order they should appear in the primary navigation.

secondary.description: Secondary section slugs (e.g. 'build-diary'). Must match folder names under /content/.

branding.description: Design tokens. Open to extension so forks can expose extra brand variables.

accentColor.description: Hex colour for the site's accent (e.g. '#0066FF').

fontHeading.description: Font family or stack used for headings.

fontBody.description: Font family or stack used for body text.

fontCode.description: Monospace font family or stack used for code blocks.

logoText.description: Short site name shown in the header/navigation.

favicon.description: Path to the favicon, relative to the public root.

features.description: Feature flags. Set to false to hide a feature without removing the code.

copyright.description: Copyright line displayed in the footer.

seo.description: SEO defaults applied when a page does not override them.

defaultImage.description: Default Open Graph image, relative to the public root.
